findings.title: Omfattende uautoriseret adgang til borgeres CPR-oplysninger
findings.summary_md: The Danish Central Person Register (CPR) confirmed a serious security incident involving unauthorized access to personal data via abuse of a Danish firm's legitimate access. The page was published 05 October 2026 at 07:37 UTC and links to the Ministry press release. Exposed data includes CPR numbers, names, and residential addresses for 8.8 million registered individuals.

findings.title: Omfattende uautoriseret adgang til borgeres CPR-oplysninger (press release)
findings.summary_md: The Danish Ministry press release (ufm.dk) confirms the unauthorized access and states the CPR administration became aware of irregular behavior in the CPR system on the evening of Friday 2 October 2026. It covers the same 8.8 million individual exposure and refers to the abuse of a firm's legitimate search access.
